fields.heading: Reset your Abundance password
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

You have requested to change the password for your Abundance account. Please click the button below and follow the reset instructions.

If you did not request this change, please contact us immediately at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666 so that we can ensure the safety of your account.

Or copy this URL into your browser:

{reset_link}
